summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title) for title controls; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
